prompts.prompt: Bug report: two people moved the same task at the same moment (one to DONE, one to OPEN) and both requests returned 200; the task ended up OPEN with no error. Look at TaskService.changeStatus and the repository, fix the race, make sure callers can tell a lost race apart from other failures, and add a test. npm test must pass. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, state your assumption in the output and in your final message, and finish.
